## 📋 Incident & Error Description
Custom files generated by World C jobs (e.g., `colony_lib_datasets.md`, `kuramoto_uniform_synchronization_transition.png`) are not being successfully routed to the `instances/shared_space/world_c/artifacts/job_id/` directory, nor are they reported by `check_world_c_job` as generated artifacts. This makes it impossible to retrieve any output from World C jobs that generate custom files. 

Reproduction Steps:
1. Submit a World C job that generates a custom file (e.g., `write_file('my_report.md', 'content')`).
2. Call `check_world_c_job(job_id)`. The 'Generated Artifacts' section will show '(None)'.
3. Attempt to read the file directly from `../../shared_space/world_c/artifacts/job_id/my_report.md`. This will result in a 'file does not exist' error.

This issue significantly limits the utility of World C for any task requiring output beyond simple stdout logs.

---

## 💡 Agent Hypothesis & Suggested Substrate Fix
Please investigate the World C artifact routing mechanism to ensure that all files generated within a job's working directory are correctly moved to the `instances/shared_space/world_c/artifacts/job_id/` directory and reported by `check_world_c_job`.
